headline: 2 children killed in separate hill collapses in Chattogram
summary: A 10-month-old infant and a 13-year-old girl died in separate landslide incidents in Sitakunda and Chashma Hill on Wednesday.
details: Two children were killed in separate landslide incidents in Chattogram on Wednesday. The accidents occurred in the Mayor Goli area of Chashma Hill in Chattogram city and in Jungle Salimpur of Sitakunda Upazila.
caption:
Two children have died in separate landslides in Chattogram after days of continuous rain.

headline: Extortion 'packages' uncovered at Dhaka Medical College morgue, run by three brothers
summary: Investigations reveal a systemic extortion racket involving 'packages' for autopsy services at major medical colleges in Dhaka.
details: A systemic extortion racket has been uncovered at the Dhaka Medical College morgue, where 'packages' are allegedly used to demand money from grieving families.
Reports indicate that three brothers are the masterminds behind this operation, controlling the services and demanding payments at various stages of the autopsy process.
Similar patterns of 'silent extortion' have also been reported at the Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College morgue, where money is demanded at every step of the post-mortem examination.
Families of the deceased are often forced to pay these illegal fees to ensure the timely release of bodies or to expedite the autopsy process.
The reports highlight a deep-seated corruption within the morgue management and the lack of oversight in these critical public health facilities.
